findings.question: Judicial & criminal justice (Criminal records, court case files and judgments): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: Potvrda sadržava cjelovite podatke iz Kaznene evidencije za određenu fizičku ili pravnu osobu, a izdaje se u svrhu ostvarivanja prava u inozemstvu ili međunarodnoj organizaciji i za druge svrhe se ne može uporabiti
findings.quote_english: The certificate contains the complete data from the Criminal Record for a specific natural or legal person, and is issued for the purpose of exercising rights abroad or in an international organisation and cannot be used for other purposes
findings.title: Potvrda iz kaznene evidencije
findings.publisher: gov.hr (Government of the Republic of Croatia, central state portal)
findings.note: The central state portal names the register and gives it a capital K; the same page says certificates are issued by the Ministarstvo pravosuđa, uprave i digitalne transformacije (Ministry of Justice, Administration and Digital Transformation). That supports the operator only indirectly. The rulebook currently in force is Pravilnik o kaznenoj evidenciji, NN 37/21 (https://narodne-novine.nn.hr/clanci/sluzbeni/2021_04_37_762.html), and the statute was last amended by NN 53/22 (ECRIS-TCN).

review.reason: The quote appears verbatim on the gov.hr page and names the register from which the certificate's data comes as "Kaznena evidencija" (the criminal records register); it names only a register, not court case files or a judgments system.
